title: Penthouse Magazine September 1992 Howard Stern Anniversary Issue
conditionDescription: Pre-owned issue, complete. Normal signs of age and storage; possible cover wear, creases and edge/corner wear. Please review the photos of the front and back covers for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Penthouse Magazine, September 1992 - Extra-Special Anniversary Issue. Cover price $5.95.

Features:
- Howard Stern cover and feature
- Out of Bounds: shocking sex and other scandals plague U.S. sports
- The Fourth Reich? Nazis on the rise
- Coed Chaos: how radical feminists trivialize rape
- Sex in Ultrasound: science takes the mystery out of love
- Sen. Strom Thurmond's black daughter?
